atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the `@tailwind` directive to insert Tailwind's `base`, `components`, `utilities`, and `variants` styles into your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Tell Tailwind which bucket (`base`, `components`, or `utilities`) a set of custom styles belongs to.

atDirectives.name: @screen
atDirectives.description: Create media queries that reference your Tailwind breakpoints by name.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Specify which Tailwind config file to use for this CSS file.
